description: Mark a checklist item done (done: true) or open again (done: false), by item_id from get_checklist. Current stored state is available through get_checklist. Do not call this tool when the user says they are under 13 (or a known higher local minimum), even with a nickname: explain that lesgooo is not available to them. Do not write another known underage child's personal data, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, IDs, passwords or verification codes. Offer ordinary non-sensitive planning text instead; do not replace a restricted request with an unrequested plan.

item_id.description: From get_checklist or add_checklist_item (the exact item text also works).

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

name: check_item
title: Tick off a checklist item
